REAL-10 步骤 '为测试排期生成预览链接': no ScheduledPost row exists in the staging database (zero rows, all orgs), and the product exposes no merchant schedule surface (/schedule 302s to /, no nav entry, no apps/web/app/schedule/page.tsx) — the only caller of sharePostPreview is Otto, and creating a post is outside this run's authorized write set.
verdicts.reason: Two independent blockers, both verified. (1) There is nothing to share: the staging database holds zero ScheduledPost rows and the app has no merchant schedule page (/schedule redirects to /, nav has no Schedule entry); the only path to sharePostPreview is an Otto action, and creating a scheduled post is not in this run's authorized writes. (2) Even given a post, sharing is switched off on this environment: the staging `web` service has 53 variables and neither MEDIA_PROXY_SECRET nor SHARE_PREVIEW_SECRET is among them, so sharePostPreview refuses ('Sharing isn't set up on this server yet.'), the asset Copy link refuses in the DOM ('Sharing links aren't configured in this environment yet.', observed), and /api/media/pub/<anything> 404s for every caller because verifyMediaToken cannot verify with an empty secret. The anonymous-boundary and money clauses that could be proven without a link were proven and are listed above.

writesMade: Clicked 'Copy link' ONCE on our own uploaded video asset /library/01M2N6WARSVDB9M5GKS9QY10EQ (a $0 mint). The server refused before any database work; no SharePreviewToken row, no ledger row, no state change of any kind. Net persisted writes this group: none.
Patched navigator.clipboard.writeText in the page's JS context to capture a minted URL (in-memory, inspection only, gone on reload). No product state touched.
boundaries: No generation, no paid confirmation card clicked; provider spend this group US$0.
Never clicked Revoke, Connect, Delete, Remove, Archive, Unarchive; never signed out; no profile/workspace/settings/billing/admin control touched.
The preview surface was only ever reached with fetch({credentials:'omit'}) — never opened in a normal tab, so no session cookie was sent to the public surface.
No link was sent anywhere external; no token exists to send.
Database access was read-only throughout (BEGIN READ ONLY / SELECT / ROLLBACK); the connection string was never written to a file or to a command line.
Railway was read for variable NAMES only; no secret value was printed, stored, or transmitted.
Only the pre-existing tab was used; no tab opened or closed; session left signed in on the same origin.
toolProblems: read_network_requests recorded nothing for requests issued from javascript_tool (the tab buffer had already dropped 403 earlier requests), so redirect Location headers had to be inferred from response type 'opaqueredirect' plus the route source instead of read off the wire.
fetch('/s/<token>', {redirect:'follow', credentials:'omit'}) threw 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' in the page context; redirect:'manual' worked and returned type 'opaqueredirect'.
findings: Staging cannot exercise ANY row of docs/specs/share-preview.md. The staging `web` service is missing both MEDIA_PROXY_SECRET and SHARE_PREVIEW_SECRET (53 variables, neither present). Consequence chain: sharePostPreview refuses before any DB read (apps/web/lib/schedule-actions.ts:664-665); the asset 'Copy link' refuses in the UI (apps/web/lib/media-link-actions.ts:50-51 — observed verbatim in the DOM); and /api/media/pub/<token> 404s unconditionally because verifyMediaToken(token, '') returns null (apps/web/app/api/media/pub/[token]/route.ts:41-42). SHARE-A1..A12 therefore have no staging receipt available at all, and the R2/media proxy path is untested outside unit tests.

The customer-preview feature has no merchant entry point on this build. /schedule redirects to /, /calendar and /posts are 404, the sidebar has no Schedule link, and there is no apps/web/app/schedule/page.tsx — the ONLY way a merchant can mint or revoke a preview link is by asking Otto (apps/web/lib/otto-actions.ts:917-918). Anyone verifying SHARE-* by hand will be stuck the same way this group was.
The staging database holds zero ScheduledPost rows across all eight orgs, so the whole schedule/publish/share chain is unrepresented in staging data.

Good news worth recording: every fail-closed path that CAN be reached behaves as the spec demands. The public media door answers a foreign tenant's Asset id, a forged token, and a Range request on either with the identical opaque 404 'Not found' and zero bytes; the session-gated /files route bounces an anonymous cross-tenant read to /login; and the preview page shows the single undifferentiated "This preview isn't available" notice with no cookie. Nothing anonymous moved the credit ledger.
